verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.x.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an official SpaceXAI API documentation index. Docs pages are served as raw .md, and xAI hosts a docs MCP server giving agents direct access to its documentation. The 404 on the doubled '.md.md' path does not contradict the working .md pages. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming llms.txt or the docs MCP, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.x.ai/llms.txt # SpaceXAI API Documentation
xAI hosts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants and agents direct access to the xAI documentation.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.x.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
